clauses.text:
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and law s of the 
United States of A m erica, and in order to ensure efficient and coordinated 
planning and review  o f w ater resources programs and projects, it is hereby 
ordered a& follow s:

clauses.label: Section 1.
clauses.text:
Section 1. Before any agency or officer thereof subm its to the Congress, or to 
any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, for approval, appropriations, or legislative 
action any report, proposal, or plan relating to a Federal or Federally assisted  
w ater and related land resources p roject or program, such report, proposal, or 
plan shall be subm itted to the D irector o f the O ffice o f M anagem ent and 
Budget.

clauses.label: Sec. 2.
clauses.text:
Sec. 2. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall examine 
each report, proposal, or plan for consistency with, and shall advise the 
agency of the relationship of the project to, the following:

clauses.label: (a)
clauses.text: (a) the policy and programs of the President;

clauses.label: (b)
clauses.text:
(b) the Principles and Standards for W ater and R elated  Land R esources 
Planning (Part 711 of Title 18 o f the Code o f Fed eral Regulations (45 F.R. 
64366)), or other such planning guidelines for w ater and related land resou rces 
planning, as shall hereafter be issued; and

clauses.label: (c)
clauses.text:
(c) other applicable law s, regulations, and requirem ents relevant to the plan­
ning process.

clauses.label: Sec. 3.
clauses.text:
Sec. 3. W hen such report, proposal, or plan is thereafter subm itted to the 
Congress, or to any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, it shall include a statem ent 
of the advice received from the O ffice of M anagem ent and Budget.

clauses.label: Sec. 4.
clauses.text: Sec. 4. Executive O rder No. 12113, as amended, is revoked.

own_original_text:
Executive Order 12322 of September 17, 1981
Water Resources Projects
By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and law s of the 
United States of A m erica, and in order to ensure efficient and coordinated 
planning and review  o f w ater resources programs and projects, it is hereby 
ordered a& follow s:
Section 1. Before any agency or officer thereof subm its to the Congress, or to 
any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, for approval, appropriations, or legislative 
action any report, proposal, or plan relating to a Federal or Federally assisted  
w ater and related land resources p roject or program, such report, proposal, or 
plan shall be subm itted to the D irector o f the O ffice o f M anagem ent and 
Budget.
Sec. 2. The Director of the Office of Management and Budget shall examine 
each report, proposal, or plan for consistency with, and shall advise the 
agency of the relationship of the project to, the following:
(a) the policy and programs of the President;
(b) the Principles and Standards for W ater and R elated  Land R esources 
Planning (Part 711 of Title 18 o f the Code o f Fed eral Regulations (45 F.R. 
64366)), or other such planning guidelines for w ater and related land resou rces 
planning, as shall hereafter be issued; and
(c) other applicable law s, regulations, and requirem ents relevant to the plan­
ning process.
Sec. 3. W hen such report, proposal, or plan is thereafter subm itted to the 
Congress, or to any com m ittee or m em ber thereof, it shall include a statem ent 
of the advice received from the O ffice of M anagem ent and Budget.
Sec. 4. Executive O rder No. 12113, as amended, is revoked.
THE WHITE HOUSE,
